state_vars.name: root
state_vars.description: Root of the compressed ancestry trie; always present (genesis node, span=[0,1)); root is exempt from the single-child compression rule

state_vars.name: seqSupport
state_vars.description: Maps each ledger sequence number to the aggregate tipSupport of all trie nodes whose tip_seq equals that sequence number; maintained in sync with node tipSupport values

operations.name: insert
operations.description: Find the node with the longest-common-prefix span for ledger (via find()); split that node's span into a prefix node and an oldSuffix child if the span extends past the divergence point; append a newSuffix child for the ledger's remaining ancestry if any; increment tipSupport on the insertion-point node by count and propagate branchSupport increments up all ancestors; increment seqSupport[ledger.seq] by count

transition_rules.expr: new_leaf if diff_seq <= ledger.tip_seq else loc

operations.name: remove
operations.description: Find the node with an exact tip-ID match for ledger (O(n) DFS); return false if not found or tipSupport==0; decrement tipSupport (clamped to existing support) and propagate branchSupport decrements up all ancestors; update seqSupport; then compress: while the affected node has tipSupport==0 and is not root, erase it if it has no children, or merge it with its sole child by unioning their spans, repeating up toward root

queries.name: tipSupport
queries.description: Return the tipSupport of the node whose span tip ID matches ledger exactly, or 0 if no such node exists

queries.name: branchSupport
queries.description: Return the branchSupport of the node that exactly matches ledger's tip ID; if no exact match, return the branchSupport of the deepest node for which ledger is a proper ancestry prefix (diffSeq > ledger.seq and ledger.seq < node.span_end); return 0 if neither condition holds

queries.name: getPreferred
queries.description: Walk the trie from root accumulating uncommitted support from seqSupport for sequence numbers below max(nextSeq, largestIssued); within each node's span advance while branchSupport > uncommitted absorbing seqSupport entries; stop inside a span and return that sub-span's tip if advancement stalls; at span end pick the child with greatest branchSupport (tie-broken by span startID, with the tie-holder getting +1 margin) and continue only if margin > uncommitted; return the current node's span tip when no child wins or the trie is empty

transition_rules.while: len(curr.children) > 0 and sum(get(seqSupport, k) for k in sorted(seqSupport) if k < max(curr.span_start + 1, largestIssued)) < curr.branchSupport and sum(get(seqSupport, k) for k in sorted(seqSupport) if k < curr.span_end) < curr.branchSupport and (sum(get(seqSupport, k) for k in sorted(seqSupport) if k < curr.span_end) == 0 or sorted(curr.children, key=lambda c: (c.branchSupport, c.span_start), reverse=True)[0].branchSupport - (sorted(curr.children, key=lambda c: (c.branchSupport, c.span_start), reverse=True)[1].branchSupport if len(curr.children) > 1 else 0) + (1 if len(curr.children) > 1 and sorted(curr.children, key=lambda c: (c.branchSupport, c.span_start), reverse=True)[0].span_start > sorted(curr.children, key=lambda c: (c.branchSupport, c.span_start), reverse=True)[1].span_start else 0) > sum(get(seqSupport, k) for k in sorted(seqSupport) if k < curr.span_end))

transition_rules.expr: sum(get(seqSupport, k) for k in sorted(seqSupport) if k < max(curr.span_start + 1, largestIssued))

curr.span_start if U_entry >= curr.branchSupport else min((k for k in sorted(seqSupport) if k >= max(curr.span_start + 1, largestIssued) and k < curr.span_end and sum(get(seqSupport, j) for j in sorted(seqSupport) if j <= k) >= curr.branchSupport), default=None)

queries.name: empty
queries.description: Return true iff root is absent or root.branchSupport == 0

queries.name: getJson
queries.description: Return JSON object containing the recursive node tree under key 'trie' and the seqSupport map under key 'seq_support'

transition_rules.expr: {n: {'span_start': n.span_start, 'span_end': n.span_end, 'tip_seq': n.tip_seq, 'tipSupport': n.tipSupport, 'branchSupport': n.branchSupport, 'children': n.children} for n in reachable}

queries.name: checkInvariants
queries.description: DFS over all nodes verifying the four structural invariants; rebuilds expectedSeqSupport from node tipSupport values and compares against seqSupport

transition_rules.expr: all(len(n.children) >= 2 for n in nodes() if n != root and n.tipSupport == 0)
all(c.parent == n for n in nodes() for c in n.children)
all(n.branchSupport == n.tipSupport + sum(c.branchSupport for c in n.children) for n in nodes())
all(any(n.tipSupport != 0 and n.tip_seq == seq for n in nodes()) for seq in seqSupport)
all(get(seqSupport, n.tip_seq, 0) == sum(m.tipSupport for m in nodes() if m.tipSupport != 0 and m.tip_seq == n.tip_seq) for n in nodes() if n.tipSupport != 0)

queries.name: dump
queries.description: Write an indented ASCII representation of the trie to an output stream for debugging

invariants.name: compression
invariants.predicate: all(n.tipSupport > 0 or len(n.children) >= 2 for n in nodes if n != root)
invariants.description: Every non-root node with zero tipSupport must have at least two children; a zero-tip-support node with exactly one child would be redundant and must be merged with that child

invariants.name: branch_support_accounting
invariants.predicate: all(n.branchSupport == n.tipSupport + sum(c.branchSupport for c in n.children) for n in nodes)
invariants.description: Every node's branchSupport equals its own tipSupport plus the sum of its immediate children's branchSupport values

invariants.name: parent_pointer_consistency
invariants.predicate: all(all(c.parent == n for c in n.children) for n in nodes)
invariants.description: For every node, each child's parent pointer must refer back to that node

invariants.name: seq_support_consistency
invariants.predicate: all(sum(n.tipSupport for n in nodes if n.tip_seq == s) == seqSupport[s] for s in seqSupport) and all(n.tipSupport == 0 or n.tip_seq in seqSupport for n in nodes)
invariants.description: seqSupport[s] must equal the total tipSupport of all nodes whose tip_seq is s; every node with positive tipSupport must have its tip_seq present as a key in seqSupport

safety_properties.name: preferred_requires_strict_margin
safety_properties.statement: getPreferred descends from a node to a child only when that child's margin over the second-best child (adjusted by the tie-breaking startID bonus) strictly exceeds the accumulated uncommitted support at that sequence number, preventing premature commitment to a minority branch

safety_properties.name: trie_remains_compressed_after_remove
safety_properties.statement: After every remove operation the compression invariant holds: no non-root node with zero tipSupport has exactly one child; such nodes are eagerly merged or erased during the post-decrement cleanup walk

safety_properties.name: support_counts_non_negative
safety_properties.statement: tipSupport and branchSupport of every node are always non-negative; remove clamps the decrement to min(count, loc->tipSupport) before applying it, so underflow cannot occur
